scope: PSF seek through bounded silent forward execution in a disposable candidate machine.

behavior.commit: Prepare a separate core from frame zero; discard rendered stereo PCM and yield after each slice. Commit only at the rounded 44100 Hz target frame.
behavior.oldRun: Retain its core, unconsumed buffers, frozen source state and original playing/paused intent until success. Cancel/failure returns to that state. Stopped-entry seeking prepares Pause; playing seeks resume; paused seeks stay paused.
behavior.ownership: One candidate at a time. Serialize late initialization/disposal, mutable beforeSeek cleanup, Stop/source/reseek/dispose and monitor fades. seekPreparing fences keyboard/editor/Capture while noninterruptible author cleanup finishes, even after Stop.
behavior.data: No long seek PCM/checkpoint cache, stems or Live/RAM history are collected during discard. Capture the exact target observation/RAM only after committing. Keep selected CH, Live/Dry, view and authored instrument.
behavior.ui: Draft only during input; commit on release/change or arrow-key release. Arrow=1s, Shift=10s. Cancel seek/Escape restores the previous position. Native actual cursor stays separate from the draft.
behavior.metadata: Strict seconds/mm:ss/hh:mm:ss parser. Unambiguous length plus valid fade is only a range hint; invalid fade is ignored. Missing/ambiguous length shows ? and an expanding five-minute window. No automatic end/fade.

exact: future 4096-frame PCM and stems after the target
nativeConformance.notDirectlyExposed: CPU GPR snapshot is not available in this ABI; CPU RAM/trace and subsequent PCM/stems continuation are compared instead.
